U-Shaped bolster: U-shaped bolster large dog bed supports head and neck; No half-side railings for max stretch and relaxation space
Waterproof and Machine Washable: Waterproof Mekiy dog bed cover protects mattress from urine and spills; Easily removable and machine washable with low heat tumble dry

Size Guide: Mekiy dog beds large size bed (36x27x7 inches) is suitable for dogs weighing less than 50 lbs; for dogs that enjoy rolling around or need extra space; sizing up will provide greater comfort

Tested Safe Materials: OEKO-TEX standard 100 certified Mekiy large sized dog bed consists of CertiPUR-US certified foam; luxury velvet and nonskid bottom; providing a secure and stable area for furry pets to rest

The memory foam is nice and thick and still has all of its shape and firmness. We’ve washed it a few times, and it’s good as the day we got it.

authors_reviews.title: Yes, I do recommend and here is why
authors_reviews.text: Great quality! My puppy absolutely loves it and is having the best nap he’s ever had at this very moment. His other bed was cramped and hot. He would usually sleep beside it rather than on it but this one is perfect for him. He is happy which makes me very happy. Teddy is a 2.5 month Yorkie. We bought him the 24”x18”. We were surprised to find a 2 year warranty card in the box when we received it. When I began putting the bed together, I was quite impressed by the care and quality they put into the bed's design and stitching. It sparked a conversation between me and my husband about the good old days when things were built and crafted to last. This bed is not indestructible but I am confident it will last him a long time. In fact, I have already ordered another so he has one in the living room as well as bedroom. I only write reviews when I am highly impressed or very disappointed in a product. It takes a little bit of work at the beginning to break apart the pieces of memory foam in the bolster from the tight vacuum seal so that it can expand properly but if you take your time with it and slowly work through it, it is worth it to see your fur baby so happy and comfortable from the care you gave it. The zippers are also good quality but when putting the paddings inside the cover, take care not to catch in the zipper… zip slow with a finger inside the zipper to create a safe barrier. It fits snug. I highly recommend this product. Thank you Mekiy for caring to make the product a great quality for our babies.
authors_reviews.author: Satisfied Customer

authors_reviews.title: This dog bed is a low price point but not low anything else - great bed for a large dog!
authors_reviews.text: I bought the 42'x30" size of this bed for my 100# Rottweiler and it's the perfect size - probably could be ok with a size smaller but this size fits her lengthwise without her head having to be on the couch arm, so she has the option to have her head either way comfortably. I don't know how well the bed will hold up over time but I am happy with it as of now and for the price I paid (on sale for $38) I am very satisfied and actually shocked at the quality and size for that price, I wasn't expecting much and was pleasantly surprised!
authors_reviews.author: JMC™️
